analysis_plan: Offline descriptive audit; written before grading outputs, after inference began. Not a pre-inference statistical registration.
accuracy: Use frozen exact-JSON grader on all completed final responses; incomplete requests fail. Report 20 distinct inputs and three repetitions separately.
cost: Include all attempts and first repetitions. Match gateway request IDs to consumption records; require counter reconciliation and complete charge coverage before reporting a complete reduction. Unknown charges are not zero.
secondary: Describe cache counts, per-repetition charges, paired differences, first-arm groups, per-case repeat instability and client latency including retry waits.
statistics: No significance test or confidence interval. Repetitions share cases, schema and gateway conditions.
decision: Preserve prior negative results, admission rejection and original-only defaults regardless of outcome.
